about.lead: Inspect the installed product identity, runtime packaging and update policy without contacting an external service.
about.no_network: Opening this page performs no network request.
about.title: About Provelume
about.trust_boundary: The Windows preview verifies installer size and SHA-256 against downloaded release metadata. It is not yet Authenticode-signed and does not independently authenticate the publisher.
about.update_policy: Update checks are manual or explicitly enabled at launcher startup. They are never hidden background traffic.
action.acknowledge_evidence: Record that I reviewed this evidence
action.acknowledge_help: Records your inspection only. It does not fix an error, retry a job or accept an acquisition.
action.aggregation_help: Group new notifications after the last dismissal. This does not pause jobs or hide the Action Center.
action.authority_help: Each choice applies only to the named capability and scope. It grants no device, provider or download permission.
action.confirm: I have reviewed the proposal, its scope and its effect.
action.confirm_redelivery: I understand that unchanged open items may be notified again.
action.confirm_scope: I understand the selected capability, scope and mode.
action.evidence_unavailable: Review evidence is unavailable. Knowledge and Management remain accessible.
action.external_channels_help: External delivery is unavailable on this surface. Enabling in-app notifications grants no browser, device or provider permission.
action.hash_help: A recorded hash is not a new verification of the file bytes.
action.history_superseded: This receipt refers to earlier evidence; it does not authorize the current proposal.
action.impact.changes_scoped_review_auth: Changes only the selected capability and scope.
action.impact.evidence_review_only: Evidence review; canonical knowledge stays unchanged.
action.impact.proposal_only_no_version_c: Creates a comparison proposal without changing any version.
action.impact.records_inspection_only: Records inspection only; errors and acquisition status do not change.
action.impact.rejects_proposal_only: Rejects only the proposal; every document and Original is preserved.
action.lead: Review the evidence and choose what happens next.
action.mode_explanations: Disabled stops delegated actions for this capability. Proposals only keeps suggestions available without dispatching their effects. Confirm each action requires a separate confirmation of the exact proposal. Controlled automatic is unavailable for these actions.
action.no_actions: No decision is available for this proposal. Follow the evidence link to the supported workflow.
action.notification_error: These notifications could not be dismissed. Reload their current state.
action.notification_stale: This notification batch has changed. Review the current notification list.
action.notification_state.clock_reversed: The clock changed; delivery is deferred
action.notification_state.deferred_quiet: Notifications are deferred during quiet hours
action.notifications_help: Notifications contain counts and links, without document content or titles. Dismissing a notification makes no review decision.
action.observation_problem: Some source evidence is incomplete or unreadable.
action.original: Original hash recorded in the evidence
action.partial: Some evidence could not be read completely. The visible count is a lower bound; review the queue status below.
action.preferences_error: Preferences were not saved. Check the values and reload if another window changed them.
action.readonly: Decisions are available only in the authorized local browser.
action.reason.producer_unavailable: The original producer evidence is unavailable; this is a retained review receipt.
action.reason.visible_unclassified: Choose a placement for this document
action.receipt_preserved: The decision receipt is retained. This review does not change or delete canonical knowledge.
action.reject_help: Preserves the documents, Originals and proposal evidence. It does not merge, quarantine or purge content.
action.reset_notification_help: Clears only notification dismissal metadata for this Instance and retains a reset receipt. Unchanged open items may be notified again. Review decisions, documents, Originals, jobs, credentials and preferences stay unchanged.
action.saved: The decision receipt was saved. The evidence remains available.
action.stale: This link refers to an earlier revision. Review the current evidence before deciding.
action.timezone_help: Use a time-zone name such as Europe/Rome or UTC. Quiet hours use this zone, including daylight-saving changes.
action.title: Needs attention
action.unreadable_items: The unavailable evidence prevents the queue contents from being established.
action.write_error: The decision could not be saved. Reload the current proposal and check its permitted actions.
action.wrong_instance: This link belongs to another Instance. No action was performed.
ai.blocked_help: Execution is blocked. Review AI mode, current qualification, consent, limits and available components. No fallback or transmission is authorized by this page.
ai.boundary: AI starts off. Saving, installing, testing and executing are separate choices. Capture, search and reading remain available.
ai.cancel_help: Cancellation requested does not mean the worker has stopped. Data already sent to an external service cannot be recalled; charges or outcome may remain unknown.
ai.candidate: Candidate only: llama.cpp b11379 with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M. Bounded Windows/Linux technical evidence exists; integrated Recommended promotion is still pending.
ai.compatibility: Only the existing chat-json-v1 HTTPS profile is configurable. Arbitrary models and executable packages are unsupported. Localhost does not prove local execution.
ai.credential_help: Enter only an external reference, never a secret. Configuration and page reads do not open the credential store.
ai.document_help: Private preview only. Coverage describes the selected representation, not the Original or other representations. No document task can be executed here.
ai.enable_help: Enablement permits admission checks in this session. It does not create or dispatch a job. Saving configuration disables execution and invalidates previews.
ai.enqueue_help: Create one durable job without executing it. Dispatch is a separate explicit action in Operations.
ai.error: Action unavailable or stale. Refresh and review the current state. No automatic retry was made.
ai.evidence: SHA-256 of independently retained stop evidence
ai.failed: Failed; review the setup before trying again
ai.model_consent: I authorize only the selected action and accept the displayed licenses for acquisition/import. Removal deletes installed model bytes, not documents.
ai.no_selection: No supported text representation is available for this Version.
ai.partial: Partial; excluded content is not sent
ai.price_block: The monetary ceiling is zero. External execution is blocked without a verified price bound and provider qualification; no paid test starts implicitly.
ai.reconcile_help: Uncertain outcome: automatic retry is forbidden. Reconciliation requires evidence that the worker stopped and explicit acknowledgement of duplicate execution or cost risk.
ai.redaction_help: Redaction covers only ASCII email patterns and exact literals in selected text. It does not guarantee anonymization or detect sensitive data across segments.
ai.reserved: Accounted resource units, including unknown usage held
ai.runtime: Select and verify locked runtime directory
ai.runtime_help: The matching application runtime must already be installed. Verification, self-test and activation are explicit. Missing bytes or unproven network isolation block use; restart requires a fresh self-test.
ai.test_consent: I approve exactly this synthetic payload, route, configuration and limits for one test. Changes or expiry invalidate this approval.
ai.test_help: This explicit test uses only the displayed public synthetic fixture. Preview sends nothing. It is not document synthesis or proof of live provider quality.
ai.title: AI & Privacy
ai.unknown: Unknown consumption is not zero. Reservations remain held until supported evidence resolves the uncertainty.

annotation.media_unavailable: Playable media was not attested for this result.
annotation.noscript: This synchronized editor requires its local script.
annotation.notice: Original bytes and engine output stay unchanged. Speaker labels are proposals, not verified identities.
annotation.ready: Preview ready. Saving appends one retained revision.
annotation.saved: Annotation saved. Open a fresh review to continue.
annotation.shared: Split segments share original anchors; no new timing or coordinates are inferred.
annotation.speaker: Proposed speaker label
annotation.title: Correct OCR and transcripts
annotation.unavailable: Evidence is unavailable or changed. Saving is disabled; retained history is preserved.
assurance.lead: Verify canonical references and exact Original bytes. Findings are reported; no repair, replacement or deletion is attempted.
assurance.not_run: No assurance report has been run yet.

capture.boundary: Originals remain untrusted. Files are not executed or scanned for malware. Downloads are explicit attachments.
capture.cameraActive: Camera is local only. Take a snapshot; no upload occurs before Queue and send.
capture.confirmPair: Pair this device with the displayed destination/Instance and only the displayed Capture scope?
capture.connected: Connected. Local queued captures retain their original device/Instance identity.
capture.fallback: Plain HTTP fallback: PWA installation, workers and share targets disabled. Local Capture still works.
capture.forgetConfirm: Forget this browser's pairing credential? Pending captures and acquired server knowledge remain.
capture.httpsHelp: Remote Capture is a separate listener, disabled by default. Configure its exact HTTPS origin, then start it explicitly with a certificate. Management remains loopback-only. QR challenges expire in 120 seconds and are single-use.
capture.installAccepted: Installation accepted by the browser. Open Capture from your apps and check that it opens in its own window without an address bar.
capture.installComplete: Capture installed. Open it from your apps; its own window has no browser address bar.
capture.installDismissed: Installation cancelled. Capture and your local outbox remain usable. Use the browser's install menu to try again.
capture.installPrompt: Finish in the browser's installation dialog near the address bar. If it is hidden, bring this browser window to the front. Capture stays usable if you cancel.
capture.installReady: Install Capture as an app. After clicking, look for the browser's installation dialog near the address bar; it may be behind this window. Confirm Install there.
capture.installUnavailable: PWA installation unavailable; Capture and the bounded outbox remain usable.
capture.installed: Capture worker ready; authenticated responses are never cached.
capture.knowledgeBoundary: Capture pairing does not authorize Knowledge. A separate expiring grant selects Sources. Use LAN, a trusted network or VPN and the explicitly configured HTTPS destination. Retrieved content stays in memory; an explicit download saves a copy.
capture.languageFallback: Some interface text is displayed in English.
capture.localOnly: Local removal cannot cancel a server submission or delete acquired knowledge. Remove this local copy?
capture.mediaDenied: Camera/microphone permission denied or unavailable; use a supported file instead.
capture.mediaReady: Media is local and not queued. Press Queue and send to retain it.
capture.mediaUnsupported: This media capability is unavailable in this browser/context.
capture.micActive: Recording locally (maximum 90 seconds). Stop to retain a WAV, then queue it.
capture.noScript: Capture requires JavaScript. Local Inbox and Knowledge remain available.
capture.offline: Offline: local queued captures are not yet acquired.
capture.owner: Local owner: devices and retained captures
capture.ownerDone: Owner action recorded. Refresh the retained result before any retry.
capture.pairNeeded: Connect / pair before sending. Pending captures remain local.
capture.paired: Paired. The credential is Capture-scoped; owner administration is not available here.
capture.payloadChanged: Receipt fingerprint/device does not match this queued capture; do not resubmit.
capture.proposal: Proposals do not classify or create Claims, Decisions, Tasks or Calendar Events. Existing review permissions govern subsequent routing.
capture.qrExpiry: One-use QR expires in 120 seconds. Destination, Instance and scope are in its contents.
capture.qrUnavailable: QR scanner unavailable. Copy the QR contents from local owner management.
capture.quarantineHelp: Rejection records quarantine with explicit retention. Undo records compensation. Neither action moves or purges Originals or canonical history. Archive/trash/purge remain separate governed Knowledge actions.
capture.rebind: Configure / rebind this destination and revoke existing credentials. Acquired knowledge is retained.
capture.retain: Keep scoped pairing on this browser for at most 30 days. Never shared with the worker cache.
capture.retainRequired: Choose explicitly whether to retain pairing before redemption; this outbox needs durable pairing across reload.
capture.retention: At most 16 items / 64 MiB. Pending bytes remain locally until an authoritative receipt. Acknowledgement removes pending bytes, not server knowledge. Local removal never cancels an accepted server submission.
capture.retrievalCleared: Retrieved content and in-memory grant cleared.
capture.retrievalConsent: Authorize this device to read the selected Sources and explicitly download their Originals.
capture.retrievalConsentRequired: Select explicit Knowledge permission before granting.
capture.retrievalError: Knowledge request failed. No retrieved content is retained. Inspect locally or retry after recovery. Status:
capture.retrievalExpired: Knowledge permission is unavailable, expired or revoked. Ask the local owner. Retrieved content has been cleared; pending captures are retained.
capture.retrievalOwnerHelp: Select one active paired device and 1–16 existing Source IDs. Granting authorizes future reads in these Sources until expiry or revocation. Submission permission is independent.
capture.retrievalReady: Separate Knowledge grant active for this session only. Sources and expiry:
capture.secure: Secure Capture surface. Only public shell resources may enter the worker cache; knowledge caching is disabled.
capture.sending: sending; server outcome not yet known
capture.shareReady: Shared item selected locally. Review it, then Queue and send through the existing outbox. It is not acquired yet.
capture.shareUnavailable: Share unavailable or interrupted. Keep the source item and use Capture file selection or the configured Drive-drop folder.
capture.storage: Local storage/quota unavailable. No capture was acknowledged or silently discarded.
capture.title: Capture
capture.uncertain: Outcome uncertain: authoritative receipt must be reconciled before retry.
capture.unsupported: Selected capture is outside the declared type/byte/capability matrix.
capture.wrongDevice: The saved capture belongs to another device/Instance. It cannot be resubmitted under a new identity.

desktop.network_notice:
Provelume will make a standard HTTPS request to GitHub Releases.

Destinations: api.github.com, github.com and GitHub's asset redirect hosts objects.githubusercontent.com and release-assets.githubusercontent.com
Selected channel (applied locally): {channel}
Purpose: read the release catalogue and verify its public manifest and tag.

GitHub receives normal connection metadata and the generic Provelume update-client User-Agent. Provelume attaches no Instance content, file names, local paths, credentials or telemetry.

exclusion_error.instance_busy: Another operation is using the Instance. No rules were changed. Preview the change again after that operation finishes.
exclusion_error.invalid_rules: Check the rule kind, relative pattern and limits; duplicate or unsupported rules are rejected.
exclusion_error.preview_busy: Two filesystem previews are still pending. Wait for them to finish before retrying.
exclusion_error.preview_limit: The preview exceeded its file, entry, depth or time limit. Select a narrower Source or a simpler rule.
exclusion_error.preview_timeout: The filesystem did not answer within five seconds. Check the mount and retry explicitly.
exclusion_error.preview_unavailable: The Source cannot be safely read. Check reachability, permissions and symbolic links, then retry.
exclusion_error.stale_preview: The Source or proposed rules no longer match this preview. Preview the change again before applying it.
exclusion_error.version_conflict: The rules changed. Reload the current version and preview your change again.
exclusions.count_help: Files inside excluded subfolders are not enumerated or included in file counts. An explicit include can override an exclusion and require checking that subtree.
exclusions.help: Paths are case-sensitive and Unicode-normalized; extensions and file types ignore case. Use * or ? within one component and ** across folders. Maximum: 32 rules, 256 characters and 16 components per pattern. File types: text, document, image, audio, video, email, archive.
exclusions.lead: Choose what future filesystem intake may read. Previously acquired records are retained.
exclusions.preview_ready: Preview ready. No rule or acquired record has changed.
exclusions.saved: Rules applied. Acquired Originals and canonical records were retained.

folder_diagnostic.mapped_drive_unavailab: The drive is not visible in this Windows session. Map it in the session running Provelume or use its UNC path. Check whether the two applications run elevated.
folder_diagnostic.mount_unavailable: Reconnect and mount the volume at its configured location, then try again.
folder_diagnostic.network_unreachable: The network folder is unreachable. Check its mount or open the same path in your file manager, then try again.
folder_diagnostic.ok: The path is readable. You can register this Source.
folder_diagnostic.path_unavailable: The path is unavailable. Select an existing readable folder and try again.
folder_diagnostic.permission_denied: Read access was denied. Check folder and share permissions for the user running Provelume, then try again.
folder_diagnostic.unsafe_path: The Source cannot contain the Instance root or overlap reserved Instance storage. Select a separate folder.
folder_diagnostic.unsupported_path: Use a filesystem path, not a URL, device path, drive-relative path or special file. For UNC, enter both server and share and select the network class.
folder_diagnostic.unsupported_platform: Windows drive and UNC paths require a Windows-hosted Instance. On this host, mount the volume through the operating system and select its local mount path.
folder_diagnostic.validation_busy: Earlier filesystem checks are still pending. Wait for the operating system to respond before retrying; no Source has been registered.
folder_diagnostic.validation_failed: The path check could not complete. Check the selected path and retry; no Source has been registered.
folder_diagnostic.validation_timeout: The filesystem did not respond within the validation limit. Check the mount and Windows session outside Provelume, then retry explicitly.
folder_diagnostic.windows_session_requir: Windows requires an authenticated session. Open the share in Explorer with the same Windows user and session as Provelume, then retry. Provelume stores no password.

google_connection.google_callback_invali: Consent expired, was cancelled or did not match. Start again.
google_connection.google_cancelled: Cancellation requested. Already acquired Originals are retained.

google_connection.google_connected: Connection test passed. Start intake when ready.

om.backup_lead: Select the exact archive for this Instance. Verification checks its bytes without restoring or extracting it.
om.capacity_scope: This host's admission policy applies when new intake checks this boundary. Running jobs continue; no files are deleted.
om.confirm_ack: I have reviewed the scope, consequences and available recovery.
om.cooperative: Pause and cancel wait for the worker's safe boundary. A requested pause is not yet a paused job. Completed effects are retained.
om.diagnostics_lead: Review a snapshot of content-free diagnostic metadata, then confirm its local export. Document text, titles, paths, accounts and credentials are excluded. Nothing is uploaded.
om.effect.finalizes_committed_repair: Recovery will finalize the receipt of the already committed repair.
om.effect.finalizes_committed_rollback: Recovery will finalize the already committed rollback to the known invalid state.
om.effect.restores_known_invalid_state: The repair was not committed. Recovery will restore its original, known invalid state.
om.effect.restores_repaired_state: The rollback was not committed. Recovery will restore the repaired state.
om.evaluation_is_not_execution: Evaluating a schedule does not mean its job ran. Success requires a matching terminal receipt.
om.lead: Follow work, inspect its evidence and review changes before running them.
om.metadata_effect: Revoking a selection prevents future work from using it. Removing a diagnostic preview also removes its local delivery history and retry capability. Review pending work and retain any evidence you need before confirming.
om.metadata_only: These actions remove only local selection or preview metadata. Exported files and selected archives are retained.
om.mode.pause_on_critical: Pause new intake at critical capacity
om.no_controls: No control is available for this current state and executor.
om.partial: This observation is partial. Missing history does not prove that work never ran or succeeded.
om.pending_recovery_lead: A repair transaction survived an interruption. Review its exact backup, current position and recorded phase before confirming reconciliation.
om.prepare_backup: Prepare and verify the recovery backup
om.preview_first: Review the selected inputs, resource estimates and authority before confirming a job.
om.receipt_unavailable: No matching terminal receipt is available. No success is inferred.
om.receipt_verified: This receipt matches the exact job and terminal result.
om.recovery_compensated: The interrupted change was compensated. Inspect the recorded validation status before preparing another operation.
om.recovery_only: Recovery mode: ordinary knowledge and scheduler operations are unavailable. Restart the normal application after a verified repair.
om.relative_path: Exact affected file relative to the Instance
om.repair_backup_scope: This recovery backup covers the complete one-file repair write set and its context. It is not a full Instance backup. The final repair needs a separate confirmation.
om.repair_lead: The supported repair retains one redundant maintenance writer file in quarantine. Different or incomplete bytes, other damage and active work cannot use this repair.
om.repair_reason.busy: A writer still holds a job lease. Wait for its safe completion or use the supported job controls, then request a new preview.
om.repair_reason.changed: The evidence changed during inspection. Request a new preview when it is stable.
om.repair_reason.different: The stranded file differs from its completed run. Preserve both files for investigation; this repair cannot choose between different contents.
om.repair_reason.findings: Deep validation found damage outside the single supported repair. Preserve the Instance and inspect the validation report.
om.repair_reason.incomplete: The completed run and matching terminal job receipt cannot be verified. Inspect their evidence before attempting a repair.
om.repair_reason.missing: The selected file or its required evidence is missing. Check the exact path.
om.repair_reason.path: Select one stranded atomic-write file in the maintenance reindex journal. This repair does not support other paths or damage.
om.repair_reason.pending: An existing recovery transaction or known invalid recovery state needs its own recovery procedure before another repair can be prepared.
om.repair_reason.space: There is insufficient observed space for the verified recovery backup. Provide enough free space and request a new preview.
om.repair_reason.unreadable: Required repair evidence is unreadable, invalid or incomplete. Preserve the Instance and inspect its validation and recovery records.
om.repair_reason.unsafe: The path contains an unsupported file type or link. No repair was prepared.
om.result_error: The operation could not proceed on the reviewed inputs. Inspect current evidence and prepare a new preview.
om.result_recorded: The result below is recorded evidence. A queued job is not completed work.
om.rollback_warning: Rollback restores the known invalid pre-repair state and blocks ordinary mutations until it is resolved.
om.title: Operations & maintenance
